up: List all compounds that appear in the document whose ChEMBL identifier is CHEMBL4417631. For each unique compound, return: (1) the molecule ChEMBL ID (from molecule_dictionary.chembl_id), (2) the preferred name (molecule_dictionary.pref_name), and (3) the canonical SMILES (compound_structures.canonical_smiles) if available. Only include compounds that are connected to the document through the compound_records table. Do not restrict by any other conditions, and do not limit the number of rows. Use DISTINCT to ensure each compound is listed once.
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT
  md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id,
  md.pref_name,
  cs.canonical_smiles
FROM docs d
JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno
LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno
WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL4417631'
